title: Who controls share links, and is disabling permanent
question: Who may create, disable, re-enable, edit and delete share links, one at a time and in bulk? Is disabling permanent or reversible? Should a project-level "public sharing off" switch exist that revokes all links and blocks new ones?
context: shared-content FR-007 says disabling is permanent while public-sharing FR-002 makes it reversible (SHARE-REQ-008).
